priceSnapshot.source: OKX Public API v5 (market/ticker), fetched via in-page fetch() from the okx.com origin using Claude in Chrome (WebFetch through the sandbox proxy returned a stale ~22h-old cached ticker; the OKX candles/liquidation feeds also needed the browser fetch to get fresh timestamps).
priceSnapshot.note: Midnight closed at 83,977.0 (02:15 COT) after adding a small spot DCA. Since then price broke down hard: three consecutive settled 1H closes (03:00, 04:00, 05:00 COT) printed below the midnight reduceIf level of 83,717.1, with a session low of 82,874.5 on a real long-liquidation cascade. Now at 83,414.1, essentially at the lower end of the post-flush range, down 0.67% vs. the midnight mark and -2.63% on the OKX 24h window.

reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H close below 82,874.5 (this session's flush low) would confirm the leg is extending toward the 82,500 invalidation rather than just a liquidity sweep.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H close back above 84,628.2 (this session's high, the pre-flush 1H open) would signal the breakdown was a false move and support rebuilding the trimmed core.

decisionBox.changed: REDUCE fired: three consecutive settled 1H closes (03:00, 04:00, 05:00 COT) printed below the midnight reduceIf level of 83,717.1, capped by a session low of 82,874.5 on a real long-liquidation cascade (~1,492 BTC notional bucketed at 83,000/82,750/83,250 in OKX's realized-liquidation feed -- the largest cluster this desk has seen in the freshness window). Trimming 30% of the spot core built up since midday/midnight. Daily structure still keeps price above all four EMAs with RSI at 61.69 (not oversold), so this is a partial de-risk in front of a confirmed short-term breakdown, not an exit of the long-term thesis.

liquidation.note: Largest realized-liquidation cluster this desk has seen: ~835.6 BTC notional (~$69.7M) of long liquidations bucketed here during the 03:00-05:00 COT flush.
~656.9 BTC notional (~$54.8M) of long liquidations, part of the same cascade.

liquidityMagnet.source: OKX public liquidation-orders API (instType=SWAP, uly=BTC-USDT, state=filled, last 100 fills), fetched fresh via in-page fetch() on okx.com and aggregated into $250 price buckets. Newest fill ~40 minutes old at fetch time -- within the freshness guard.
liquidityMagnet.note: Below-spot clusters (83,000/82,750/83,250) total ~1,492.6 BTC notional vs. ~50.8 BTC above at 83,500 -- liquidity is overwhelmingly skewed toward pulling price down, consistent with a real deleveraging event rather than a stale/orphan cluster.
